name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-faceted-search
title: Faceted Search Web Part
shortDescription: A React-based SharePoint Framework web part that searches the current SharePoint site with faceted filtering.
longDescription: This sample demonstrates a React-based SharePoint Framework web part that queries the current site through the read-only SharePoint Search REST endpoint (/_api/search/query), displays search results and metadata, and supports refiner-based filtering with loading, empty, error, and retry states.

references.name: SharePoint Search REST API overview
references.description: Learn how to add search functionality to client and mobile applications using the SharePoint Search REST service.

references.name: Overview of SharePoint client-side web parts
references.description: Learn about SharePoint client-side web parts, which execute in the browser and can be built with modern client-side development tools and frameworks such as React.
